messages:
maria: Heads-up — sudden 5xx spike on /v1/generate since deploy 2026-03-17T12:30Z. Grafana panel: https://grafana.redwood/internal/p/502-surge (5xx rate jumped ~8% -> ~45% in ~3m)

deploy-bot: Deploy started: deploy/2026-03-17-sweep-214 by @raj

david: Is this a canary sweep? Which config key changed?

maria: kv_route_tag was flipped from 'stable' -> 'kv:42' as part of the sweep. Traffic slice 12% routed to kv:42.

raj: suspect mis-tagging: kv:42 isn't registered with the auth shim we use for hosted inference, so requests hit upstream without auth middleware -> gateway 502s/timeouts.

carla: Logs (gateway): `error: upstream: no healthy targets for route kv:42` and `auth-middleware: token validation failed: shim not found`

support: CS report: two customers (acme-co, beta-inc) opened tickets complaining about errors / timeouts. Tickets #3245, #3246. They see 502s and elevated latency.

ben: Ok, mitigation plan: stop canary traffic and rollback kv_route_tag to stable. Raj, can you execute rollback and patch routing?

raj: Running rollback now: `rwctl config set kv_route_tag=stable --env=prod --reason="502 spike from deploy/2026-03-17-sweep-214"`

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated: roll/2026-03-17-rb-001 by @raj

maria: Repro snippet from failing client:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -H "x-rw-route: kv:42" -X POST -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' https://api.redwood/v1/generate
# response: HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
# body: {"error":"upstream_error","message":"no healthy upstream for route kv:42"}
```

david: I can reproduce against a gateway-mock: `make smoke GATEWAY=canary route=kv:42` — same 502 and auth shim missing.

carla: Short-term workaround would be to strip x-rw-route at ingress so callers hit stable path, but that would be a risky hotpatch. Prefer full rollback.

support-bot: Notified CS to message affected customers with mitigation ETA 15-30m.

raj: Rollback API returned success. Patching router rules to remove kv:42 binding from slice. Applying config update to control plane.

maria: Monitoring: 5xx rate dropping 45% -> 12% within 4 minutes of rollback start.

ben: Keep canary disabled. Postmortem ops: assign owners and capture timeline. Also add CI/validation guard to reject unknown kv route tags.

david: Filed INF-903: "deploy sweep allowed unknown kv route tag; missing auth shim detection" and attached logs/smoke results.

maria: Current numbers: 5xx stabilized at ~1.2% (baseline ~0.9%). Rolling full verification for customer tickets; CS will update.

raj: Follow-ups: revert the sweep script change that allowed freeform tags, add an e2e check for "route tag -> auth shim exists", and add a canary policy that fails if upstream target list is empty.

carla: I'll draft the incident postmortem and include repro steps, logs, and suggested pre-deploy checks.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete: roll/2026-03-17-rb-001 SUCCESS

maria: Thanks everyone — incident is mitigated. Handing off to postmortem and CS follow-up. :white_check_mark:
